kwargs.content:
You are analyzing a COMPLETE multi-page Proof of Delivery (POD) PDF packet in a SINGLE request.

Read EVERY attached page and return ONLY valid JSON.

Do NOT invent, infer, merge, reconcile, or guess any values.

IMPORTANT:
- T3RA Logistics is a BROKER, never the carrier.
- Every page must be analyzed independently.
- Values must only be extracted if they are visibly present on that page.
- If a value is not visible, return an empty string (`""`), `null`, `false`, or an empty array as appropriate.
- Do not include explanations, markdown, comments, or code fences.
- Output ONLY the JSON object.

Return EXACTLY this top-level schema:

{
  "document_summary": {
    "page_count": 0,
    "page_types_seen": [],
    "notes": ""
  },
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_number": 1,
      "page_type": "BILL_OF_LADING" | "LUMPER_RECEIPT" | "ITEMIZED_LIST" | "RATE_CONFIRMATION" | "UNKNOWN",

      "fields": [
        {
          "key": "carrier_name" | "po_number" | "pickup_location" | "pickup_address" | "delivery_location" | "delivery_address" | "stamp_company_name",
          "value": "",
          "confidence": 1,
          "context_snippet": ""
        }
      ],
      "identifiers": [
        {
          "printed_label": "",
          "value": "",
          "context_snippet": ""
        }
      ],
      "location_blocks": [
        {
          "printed_label": "",
          "location_name": "",
          "address": ""
        }
      ],
      "signatures": [
        {
          "owner": "receiver" | "shipper" | "driver" | "carrier",
          "label": "",
          "reasoning": ""
        }
      ],
      "proof_of_receipt": {
        "has_receiver_signature": false,
        "has_stamp": false,
        "has_delivery_sticker": false,
        "delivery_number": "",
        "reasoning": ""
      },
      "pallets_shipped": null,
      "damage_detected": false,
      "damage_detail": "",
      "stop_times": [
        {
          "pickup_checkin_time": "",
          "pickup_checkout_time": "",
          "delivery_checkin_time": "",
          "delivery_checkout_time": ""
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Extraction Rules

1. Analyze every page independently.
   - Do not copy values from one page to another.
   - Only extract values that are visibly present on that page.

2. Reference IDs
   - Extract every visible labeled identifier, including State Order No., PO,
     Customer PO, BOL, Pickup, Delivery, and appointment numbers.
   - Copy the printed label exactly into `printed_label`; it is free text and
     must never be forced into a PO/BOL/pickup/delivery category.
   - Preserve formatting and leading zeroes exactly.
   - Never normalize or modify IDs.

3. Location Blocks
   - Extract every visible Shipper / From / Origin / Consignee / To / Destination
     block into `location_blocks` with its exact printed label.
   - A Bill of Lading may contain multiple identifiers and multiple location blocks.
   - Do not infer missing addresses.

4. Stop Assignment
   - Never determine whether a page belongs to pickup or delivery.
   - Never assign an identifier to a stop. Turvo will match identifiers and
     locations independently; one page may evidence multiple stops.

5. Signatures
   Extract EVERY visibly signed signature on the page into the `signatures` array.
   Only include signatures where ink, a written name, or an electronic signature
   is actually present. Do NOT include empty/unsigned signature boxes.

   A page may have multiple signatures (e.g. shipper + carrier + consignee all signed).
   Extract each one as a separate object.

   Owner attribution rules (based on PHYSICAL LOCATION of the signature-specifically which labeled box or field it appears inside or immediately adjacent to):

   Set "shipper" ONLY when the signature is inside or directly next to a box
   labeled: Shipper, Ship From, Origin, Sender

   Set "driver" ONLY when inside/next to: Driver, Carrier Driver, Delivered by,
   Driver Signature

   Set "carrier" ONLY when inside/next to: Carrier, Trucking Company

   Set "receiver" for:
   - Signature inside a box labeled Consignee, Received by, Receiver, RECVR,
     Delivered to, Customer signature
   - Signature that is NOT inside any labeled box (floating/random on the page)
   - Signature whose nearby label does not clearly match shipper/driver/carrier

   DEFAULT is "receiver". Only override to shipper/driver/carrier when there is
   an explicit labeled box clearly attributing the signature to that party.

   `label` — copy the exact printed text of the signature box label (e.g.
   "Consignee Signature", "Driver Signature:", "Received by"). If no label
   is visible, use empty string.

   `reasoning` — one short sentence explaining why this owner was chosen
   (e.g. "Ink inside Consignee Certification box", "Floating signature with no label").

6. Proof of Receipt
   Count receiver proof only when evidence clearly belongs to the Receiver/Consignee.

   Receiver proof includes:
   - Receiver signature (any signature in `signatures` with `owner: "receiver"`)
   - Consignee signature
   - RECVR signature
   - Receiver stamp
   - Delivery sticker (affixed labels from retailers like Walmart, DC stickers,
     TCR-style white labels with delivery/appointment numbers)
   - Stamp stating:
     - Received
     - Cleared
     - Delivered
     - Delivery Confirmed

   Do NOT count as receiver proof:
   - Driver signatures
   - Carrier signatures
   - Shipper signatures
   - Broker signatures

   Set `has_receiver_signature` to true if ANY signature in the `signatures`
   array has `owner: "receiver"`.

   Set `has_delivery_sticker` to true for any affixed delivery label (retailer
   stickers, DC labels, appointment confirmation stickers).

   `reasoning` — one short sentence explaining the proof of delivery evidence
   (e.g. "Consignee signed in certification box and Walmart sticker affixed",
   "No receiver evidence found on this page").

7. Stop Times
   Extract only visibly printed check-in/check-out times.

   Populate:
   - pickup_checkin_time
   - pickup_checkout_time
   - delivery_checkin_time
   - delivery_checkout_time

   Convert to ISO-8601 UTC ONLY if the document provides sufficient date and timezone information.
   Otherwise return an empty string.

8. Damage
   Detect and extract:
   - Damage
   - Shortage
   - Refusal
   - Claims
   - Exception notes

9. Rate Confirmation
   Classify a page as RATE_CONFIRMATION only when the page is explicitly titled "Rate Confirmation."

10. Confidence
   Confidence must be a numeric value between 0 and 1.

11. Output Requirements
   - Return valid JSON only.
   - No markdown.
   - No explanations.
   - No comments.
   - No additional keys.
   - Preserve printed capitalization, punctuation, spacing, and leading zeroes wherever applicable.

kwargs.template: Analyze the attached complete POD PDF across all pages and return the JSON schema above.
